name: Internetworking
description: Enterprise Core Networking ตามหลักสูตร CCNP ENCOR ครอบคลุม Packet Forwarding, Spanning Tree, MST, VTP/DTP/EtherChannel, IP Routing, EIGRP, OSPF/OSPFv3, BGP, Multicast และ QoS

chapters.title: Packet Forwarding
chapters.description: OSI/TCP-IP, Layer 2 Forwarding, VLAN, Trunk, MAC Address Table, Process Switching, CEF และ TCAM

chapters.title: Spanning Tree Protocol
chapters.description: 802.1D STP Fundamentals, Port States/Types, Root Bridge Election, Path Cost, Topology Change และ RSTP

chapters.title: Advanced STP Tuning
chapters.description: Root Bridge Placement, Port Cost/Priority Tuning, Root Guard, PortFast, BPDU Guard/Filter, Loop Guard และ UDLD

chapters.title: Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol
chapters.description: CST/PVST/MST Topologies, MST Region, IST, MST Configuration/Tuning และ Region Boundary Design

chapters.title: VLAN Trunks and EtherChannel Bundles
chapters.description: VTP Roles/Versions, DTP Modes, EtherChannel, PAgP/LACP, Load Balancing และการแก้ปัญหา Port-Channel

chapters.title: IP Routing Essentials
chapters.description: Routing Algorithms, Path Selection, Administrative Distance, Metrics, Static Routes ประเภทต่างๆ และ VRF

chapters.title: EIGRP
chapters.description: EIGRP Terminology, Topology Table, Feasibility Condition, Classic/Wide Metrics, DUAL Convergence และ Summarization

chapters.title: OSPF
chapters.description: LSA/LSDB/SPT, OSPF Areas, Inter-Router Communication, Neighbor States, DR/BDR, Configuration และ Optimizations

chapters.title: Advanced OSPF
chapters.description: OSPF Areas/ABR, LSA Types 1-5, Discontiguous Networks, Path Selection, Interarea Summarization และ Route Filtering

chapters.title: OSPFv3
chapters.description: OSPFv3 Fundamentals, LSA Types ใหม่, Link-Local Communication, Configuration, Summarization และ IPv4 Address Family Support

chapters.title: BGP
chapters.description: AS Numbers, Path Attributes, Loop Prevention, iBGP/eBGP, BGP Messages/States, Configuration, BGP Tables, Aggregation และ MP-BGP for IPv6

chapters.title: Advanced BGP
chapters.description: BGP Multihoming, Conditional Matching (ACL/Prefix List/Regex), Route Maps, Route Filtering, BGP Communities และ Best-Path Algorithm

chapters.title: Multicast
chapters.description: Multicast Fundamentals, Class D Addressing, Layer 2 Mapping, IGMPv2/v3, IGMP Snooping, PIM-DM/SM, RPF และ Rendezvous Points

chapters.title: QoS
chapters.description: สาเหตุปัญหาคุณภาพ, QoS Models (Best Effort/IntServ/DiffServ), Classification & Marking (CoS/DSCP/PHB), Policing/Shaping และ Congestion Management
topics: The Need for QoS & Delay Types
